notes.title: One of the worst games of all time got a Steam release, but is it even that bad compared to our current hell of asset-flips and Steam shovelware?
notes.notes: Give it some credit: it's not every game that lets you edit the text in its installation wizard while you wait for setup to conclude. But Big Rigs dares to be so bold. It is also so bold as to allow you to accelerate to literally infinite speeds by holding reverse, to have absolutely zero collision, and to splatter a .bmp of a three-handled trophy on the screen whenever you reach the end of a track, underlined by royalty-free WordArt reading "YOU'RE WINNER.".. Read more.

notes.title: 🌍Experimental Multilingual Support Now Available
notes.notes:
Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/randomurlthatidecidedtomake?snr=1_2108_9__2107]sex[/url],We’ve added experimental support for multiple languages in Big Rigs: Over the Road Racing!

[h1]🧪 What's New[/h1]
The game now supports 12 languages in addition to English. This update includes localized menu graphics and text where applicable.

[h1]🌐 Supported Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*] English 
[*] Chinese 
[*] Spanish 
[*] Russian 
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean 
[*] Portuguese
[*] German 
[*] French
[*] Polish 
[*] Italian
[*] Arabic 
[/list]

[h1]💻 Language Detection[/h1]
[h2]On PC (Windows):[/h2]
The game will automatically detect and use your system language at startup.

[h2]On Steam Deck (Game Mode):[/h2]
To use a specific language (other than English), you must manually set a Launch Option:

[h2]How to Set Language on Steam Deck:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Open your game in the Library.
[*] Press the Options (⋯) button or tap the gear icon.
[*] Select Properties > General.
[*] Under Launch Options, enter one of the following lines:
[/list]
Chinese:  
HOST_LC_ALL=zh_CN.UTF-8 %command%
Spanish:  
HOST_LC_ALL=es_ES.UTF-8 %command%
Russian:
 HOST_LC_ALL=ru_RU.UTF-8 %command%
Japanese:
HOST_LC_ALL=ja_JP.UTF-8 %command%
Korean:
HOST_LC_ALL=ko_KR.UTF-8 %command%
Portuguese: 
HOST_LC_ALL=pt_BR.UTF-8 %command%
German:
HOST_LC_ALL=de_DE.UTF-8 %command%
French:
HOST_LC_ALL=fr_FR.UTF-8 %command%
Polish: 
HOST_LC_ALL=pl_PL.UTF-8 %command%
Italian:
HOST_LC_ALL=it_IT.UTF-8 %command%
Arabic :
HOST_LC_ALL=ar_EG.UTF-8 %command%
English : 
HOST_LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 %command%

[h1]Feedback & Requests[/h1]
This feature is experimental, and your feedback matters!
If you encounter localization issues or want to request support for another language, please contact us at:

🔗[url= https://margariteentertainment.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new] https://margariteentertainment.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new[/url]

—Margarite Entertainment

notes.title: Don't Cheat in Big Rigs: Play Fair Leaderboards
notes.notes:
At Margarite Entertainment, we believe that everyone is winner when they play "Big Rigs: Over the Road Racing"! However, we've noticed some suspicious activity on the leaderboards recently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551130/c75faea75261b831478a4be34b0d8fe9f63202ce.png[/img]
While we are not implementing anti-cheat systems, we will remove suspicious and impossible data from the leaderboards. Any repeat offenders may have their scores permanently removed, you have been warned.

If you’ve achieved an almost impossible time (such as completing the game in just milliseconds), we encourage you to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/bigrigs]submit your run for verification[/url] on Speedrun.com. Otherwise, your score will not be accepted.

Of course, this won’t affect your ability to play the game or modify files. It's just that if you want to participate in the global Leaderboards, you'll need to follow these guidelines.

🌍🏆Check out the Big Rig Global Leaderboard🚛🔥:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3598130/leaderboards/16280720]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3598130/leaderboards/16280720[/url]

notes.title: Big Rigs, a strong contender for any 'worst games of all time' list, currently has a Mostly Positive user rating on Steam because democracy is broken
notes.notes: Big Rigs: Over the Road Racing was misnamed. It should have been called Big Rigs: Through the Road Racing, or possibly Through the Nearby Buildings and Also Bridges. The 2003 truck racing game infamously lacked collision, meaning you could drive through anything, including your competitor... Read more.
